SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, c.nickname AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, o.pet_id, p.name AS pet_name, p.breed AS pet_breed, sp.name AS package_name, o.total_amount, o.paid_amount, o.status, o.pay_status, o.appointment_time, o.created_at FROM service_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN pet p ON o.pet_id = p.id LEFT JOIN service_package sp ON o.package_id = sp.id WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND o.status = #{status}
AND ( o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
